propositions: 13 orphaned reverse[jira_key] entries exist in bindings.json for REB-410 through REB-422 with no corresponding forward bindings, all pointing to deleted ZZ-*TEST fixture tickets from a retired environment (env_id ade0f2ef-*, not 01a1a015-*)
rebar bridge fsck reports store_integrity=13 on every canary run, masking genuine future integrity faults and triggering false binding_drift alerts

The reverse-orphan leak persists because unbind() only pops reverse keys when the forward entry carries a jira_key, so paths that remove forward entries without paired reverse cleanup permanently orphan those keys

Repair deletes the 13 orphaned reverse entries (not tombstone into bindings-retired.json) through BindingStore and commit_and_push_tickets_branch, reducing store_integrity from 13 to 0 and eliminating alert conditions
After repair, rebar bridge fsck confirms store_integrity=0 with bindings=2111, reverse=2111, and zero orphans; all acceptance criteria met and remote origin/tickets verified clean
